method: Same frozen capped pixels; overview plus four overlapping horizontal bands. Explicit tiling, not native pan-and-scan. Tile-specific instruction differs from historical prompt; two same-prompt overview controls per DPI.
prompt: All supplied images depict the SAME single book page. The first is the full-page overview. Any following images are magnified horizontal bands in top-to-bottom order, with small overlaps. Use the overview for layout and the bands for detail. Transcribe the page ONCE in normal reading order; do not repeat overlapping text. Preserve printed spelling, punctuation, footnotes and visible line-final hyphens. Do not complete words cut off at the page edge. Extract all readable text and format it as structured Markdown.
